surface: react-grab 0.2.0 element-grab overlay ported to Octane: init lifecycle, shadow-DOM overlay, selection/copy flow, context menu, plugins, global API, and the complete option/state/theme type surface.
divergences: Component ancestry resolves through Octane scopes instead of React fibers; src/bippy/ is a clean-room reimplementation over Octane instrumentation.
options.freezeReactUpdates freezes Octane renderer updates; the option name is retained for API parity.
ssr: Server rendering is covered by tests/ssr/isomorphic-import.test.ts: the package imports isomorphically and init stays inert without a DOM.
